question:
I once volunteered to go in goal for the last 10 minutes of a Champions League match after my club's substitute keeper was sent off.
Incredibly, I didn't concede and saved a free-kick.
I've played with the likes of Haaland, De Bruyne & Pulisic.

I've won six Premier League titles and completed a continental treble in 2023.
Following my time at Manchester City, I spent a short spell in Italy before joining Burnley.
I've played with the likes of Bale, Rodri & João Félix.

In 2012 I was named PFA Young Player of the Year, beating out the likes of Sergio Agüero and Gareth Bale.
Yet it would be several years before I won my first piece of silverware as a professional.
I've been managed by Pochettino, Guardiola & Scott Parker.
